cover_glass.note: 原文：WD 为盖玻片像方表面到第一面的距离；全文未给盖玻片厚度

working_distance.text: WD denotes the working distance (the distance d0 along the optical axis between the image-side surface of a cover glass and the surface located closest to the object in the first lens group G1)

wavelength.text: Numerals at the left end denote the order of lens surface from the object-side, r denotes the radius of curvature of the lens surface, d denotes the distance between the lens surfaces, and n and v denote a refractive index for the d-line (λ=587.6 nm) and the Abbe number, respectively.

tube_lens.text: As shown in FIG. 15, the imaging lens is constituted by a positive cemented lens G4 of a double-convex lens and a double-concave lens, a negative cemented lens G5 of a double-convex lens and a double-concave lens, and a prism P.

doubts: 面1与面2之间：表中 cond3（v1p − v1n）印为 15.3，但面2 ν=50.8（L1p）减面1 ν=25.5（L1n）得 25.3。读法A：(3) 的 15.3 为印刷误植，应为 25.3；读法B：表中面1或面2的 ν 有误。JSON 按印刷值 15.3 记入 header.other，未修改。
header.beta 原文印为 '10×'，无符号；按印刷值记为 10，未补负号（schema 示例为 -10），请确认符号约定。
